provenance: Hand-authored stand-in for the credential-free demo and CI. NOT recorded from IBM Bob and NOT evidence about Bob's diagnostic quality.

diagnosis.root_cause: request_timeout_seconds in config/auth.yaml was cut to 0.001s under load. AuthService reads it as its request deadline, so every login call times out before the identity provider can answer; the CI failure log shows the authentication tests timing out.
assumptions: The timeout value is the regression, not the identity provider's latency
A multi-second deadline is the intended production setting
unresolved_uncertainty: Whether the load that motivated the cut has been addressed elsewhere

remediation.summary: Restore auth request_timeout_seconds to 5 in config/auth.yaml.
